description: Store an AI score and reason in private per-photo plug-in metadata in this catalog. Provide score, reason or both. Score is an integer from 0 to 100; reason is at most 1024 characters. Omitted fields stay unchanged; an empty string clears a field. Does not change IPTC, XMP, keywords, or export metadata. Returns updated (photos written); unknown IDs are not_found. Rules: give score or reason.

photo_ids.description: Array of photo IDs or file paths
